_help: Add your own category by copying any block. visuals: stock = real footage from Pexels, ai = AI images in the look named by style (see styles.json). news: true = facts come from today's news (Google News RSS) and the script may only use those facts. youtube_category: YouTube's category id. mood picks voice pace and assets/music/<mood>/. edit: editing style from edits.json (default: energetic for Shorts, cinematic for long).

news.label: News
news.tone: A clear, neutral news explainer. Only facts from the sources given. Say who reported what. No opinions, no speculation.

crime.label: Crime
crime.tone: A calm, serious true-crime explainer of a publicly reported case. Only facts from the sources given. Use 'accused' / 'police say' wording. Never name victims who are minors, never show or describe gore, never claim guilt that a court has not decided.

drama.label: Drama story
drama.tone: An original fictional family/relationship drama with a twist, told by a narrator. Clearly fiction. Emotional, simple language.

music.label: Music stories
music.tone: Stories behind songs, singers, ragas and instruments, and music history. Do not quote copyrighted song lyrics. Never play a copyrighted song.

animation.label: Animated story
animation.tone: An original animated story with a clear moral, fun for all ages.

2d.label: 2D cartoon story
2d.tone: An original 2D cartoon story for kids and families, simple words, a moral at the end.

3d.label: 3D cartoon story
3d.tone: An original 3D-animation style story with lovable characters and a twist.

horror.label: Horror story
horror.tone: An original spooky story, suspense over gore. Clearly fiction.

facts.label: Facts / explainer
facts.tone: A surprising, well-known-to-be-true facts explainer. Never invent numbers; if unsure, say it without a number.

motivational.label: Motivational
motivational.tone: A motivational talk with one practical idea and a real-life style example. No fake quotes attributed to real people.

mythology.label: Mythology
mythology.tone: A respectful retelling of a well-known Indian mythology story, as told in common tradition.

tech.label: Tech
tech.tone: A clear tech news explainer for normal people. Only facts from the sources given.

devotional.label: Devotional / Bhakti
devotional.tone: Respectful bhakti content: stories of saints and deities as told in common tradition, the meaning of well-known mantras, aartis and festivals, and what they teach for daily life. Calm, warm, sincere. Never mock any faith, never claim miracles or cures as fact, never make health or money promises.

bhajan.label: Bhajan / music video
bhajan.tone: A devotional music video. The audio is the creator's own song or a track they have the rights to; the job here is only pictures, lyrics on screen, title and description.
